name: git-branch-create
description: Create and check out a new branch for a ticket or work-item id (Jira key, GitHub issue, Linear id, etc.) from the latest integration branch. Names use the ticket key as prefix plus an informational slug (e.g. proj-123-add-oauth). Use when the user invokes /git-branch-create, asks to create a branch for a ticket, or wants to start work on a named issue with a correctly named branch.
